lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪੇ ਵੇਖੈ ਆਪੇ ਸਚਿ ਲਾਏ ॥੪॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: naanak aape vekhai aape sach laae ||4||7||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the Lord Himself sees all; He Himself links us to the Truth. ||4||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 3 ||
lines.translation: Dhanaasaree, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਵੈ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: naavai kee keemat mit kahee na jaai ||
lines.translation: The value and worth of the Lord's Name cannot be described.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਜਨ ਧੰਨੁ ਜਿਨ ਇਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: se jan dha(n)n jin ik naam liv laai ||
lines.translation: Blessed are those humble beings, who lovingly focus their minds on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਾਚੀ ਸਾਚਾ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramat saachee saachaa veechaar ||
lines.translation: True are the Guru's Teachings, and True is contemplative meditation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸੇ ਦੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: aape bakhase de veechaar ||1||
lines.translation: God Himself forgives, and bestows contemplative meditation. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਚਰਜੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਿ ਸੁਣਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: har naam acharaj prabh aap sunaae ||
lines.translation: The Lord's Name is wonderful! God Himself imparts it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਲੀ ਕਾਲ ਵਿਚਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: kalee kaal vich guramukh paae ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: In the Dark Age of Kali Yuga, the Gurmukhs obtain it. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਮੂਰਖ ਮੂਰਖ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ham moorakh moorakh man maahi ||
lines.translation: We are ignorant; ignorance fills our minds.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਭ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: haumai vich sabh kaar kamaahi ||
lines.translation: We do all our deeds in ego.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਹੰਉਮੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur parasaadee ha(n)umai jaai ||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, egotism is eradicated.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸੇ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: aape bakhase lae milaai ||2||
lines.translation: Forgiving us, the Lord blends us with Himself. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਖਿਆ ਕਾ ਧਨੁ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: bikhiaa kaa dhan bahut abhimaan ||
lines.translation: Poisonous wealth gives rise to great arrogance.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਹੰਕਾਰਿ ਡੂਬੈ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: aha(n)kaar doobai na paavai maan ||
lines.translation: Drowning in egotism, no one is honored.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: aap chhod sadaa sukh hoee ||
lines.translation: Forsaking self-conceit, one finds lasting peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: guramat saalaahee sach soee ||3||
lines.translation: Under Guru's Instruction, he praises the True Lord. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸਾਜੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape saaje karataa soi ||
lines.translation: The Creator Lord Himself fashions all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: tis bin doojaa avar na koi ||
lines.translation: Without Him, there is no other at all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਚਿ ਲਾਏ ਸੋਈ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis sach laae soee laagai ||
lines.translation: He alone is attached to Truth, whom the Lord Himself so attaches.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਆਗੈ ॥੪॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naam sadaa sukh aagai ||4||8||
lines.translation: O Nanak, through the Naam, lasting peace is attained in the hereafter. ||4||8||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਧਨਾਸਿਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਘਰੁ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: raag dhanaasiree mahalaa 3 ghar 4 ||
lines.translation: Raag Dhanaasaree, Third Mehl, Fourth House:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਭੀਖਕ ਭੇਖਾਰੀ ਤੇਰੇ ਤੂ ਨਿਜ ਪਤਿ ਹੈ ਦਾਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: ham bheekhak bhekhaaree tere too nij pat hai daataa ||
lines.translation: I am just a poor beggar of Yours; You are Your Own Lord Master, You are the Great Giver.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੋਹੁ ਦੈਆਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਮੰਗਤ ਜਨ ਕੰਉ ਸਦਾ ਰਹਉ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: hohu daiaal naam dehu ma(n)gat jan ka(n)u sadaa rahau ra(n)g raataa ||1||
lines.translation: Be Merciful, and bless me, a humble beggar, with Your Name, so that I may forever remain imbued with Your Love. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੰਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ਸਾਚੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਟਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: ha(n)u balihaarai jaau saache tere naam vitahu ||
lines.translation: I am a sacrifice to Your Name, O True Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਏਕੋ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: karan kaaran sabhanaa kaa eko avar na doojaa koee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The One Lord is the Cause of causes; there is no other at all. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਹੁਤੇ ਫੇਰ ਪਏ ਕਿਰਪਨ ਕਉ ਅਬ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: bahute pher pae kirapan kau ab kichh kirapaa keejai ||
lines.translation: I was wretched; I wandered through so many cycles of reincarnation. Now, Lord, please bless me with Your Grace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੋਹੁ ਦਇਆਲ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਐਸੀ ਬਖਸ ਕਰੀਜੈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: hohu daiaal darasan dehu apunaa aisee bakhas kareejai ||2||
lines.translation: Be merciful, and grant me the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan; please grant me such a gift. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਨਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਰਮ ਪਟ ਖੂਲੑੇ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhanat naanak bharam pat khoolhe gur parasaadee jaaniaa ||
lines.translation: Prays Nanak, the shutters of doubt have been opened wide; by Guru's Grace, I have come to know the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੀ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ਹੈ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥੩॥੧॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: saachee liv laagee hai bheetar satigur siu man maaniaa ||3||1||9||
lines.translation: I am filled to overflowing with true love; my mind is pleased and appeased by the True Guru. ||3||1||9||

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੧ ਚਉਪਦੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 4 ghar 1 chaupade ||
lines.translation: Dhanaasaree, Fourth Mehl, First House, Chau-Padhay:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸੰਤ ਭਗਤ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਸਭਿ ਪਾਪ ਨਿਵਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo har sevahi sa(n)t bhagat tin ke sabh paap nivaaree ||
lines.translation: Those Saints and devotees who serve the Lord have all their sins washed away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਊਪਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਰਖੁ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਤੁਮ ਜੁ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: ham oopar kirapaa kar suaamee rakh sa(n)gat tum j piaaree ||1||
lines.translation: Have Mercy on me, O Lord and Master, and keep me in the Sangat, the Congregation that You love. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਕਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਉ ਬਨਵਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: har gun kahi na sakau banavaaree ||
lines.translation: I cannot even speak the Praises of the Lord, the Gardener of the world.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਪਾਪੀ ਪਾਥਰ ਨੀਰਿ ਡੁਬਤ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪਾਖਣ ਹਮ ਤਾਰੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: ham paapee paathar neer dubat kar kirapaa paakhan ham taaree || rahaau ||
lines.translation: We are sinners, sinking like stones in water; grant Your Grace, and carry us stones across. ||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਲਾਗੇ ਬਿਖੁ ਮੋਰਚਾ ਲਗਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਾਧ ਸਵਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: janam janam ke laage bikh morachaa lag sa(n)gat saadh savaaree ||
lines.translation: The rust of poison and corruption from countless incarnations sticks to us; joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, it is cleaned away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਬੈਸੰਤਰਿ ਤਾਇਓ ਮਲੁ ਕਾਟੀ ਕਟਿਤ ਉਤਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jiu ka(n)chan baisa(n)tar taaio mal kaatee katit utaaree ||2||
lines.translation: It is just like gold, which is heated in the fire, to remove the impurities from it. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਨੁ ਜਪਉ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: har har japan japau din raatee jap har har har ur dhaaree ||
lines.translation: I chant the chant of the Name of the Lord, day and night; I chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, Har, and enshrine it within my heart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅਉਖਧੁ ਜਗਿ ਪੂਰਾ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: har har har aukhadh jag pooraa jap har har haumai maaree ||3||
lines.translation: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, Har, is the most perfect medicine in this world; chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, I have conquered my ego. ||3||
